_doc: PROJECT-LEVEL Claude Code permissions. Copy this file to .claude/settings.local.json (gitignored) and replace <PLACEHOLDERS> with this project's real values. Generic patterns (npm run *, npx playwright *, MCP read tools, gh secret set, etc.) are already in the user-level ~/.claude/settings.json and apply to every project. Add ONLY patterns that are unique to this project here.

_replace.<PROJECT_NAME>: the kebab-case project name, e.g. biteiq, my-app
_replace.<PROJECT_DIR>: absolute path to project_code root, e.g. d:\personal\projects\my-app\project_code\app
_replace.<VERCEL_URL>: deployed web URL hostname only, e.g. my-app.vercel.app
_replace.<API_URL>: deployed API URL hostname when API is split, e.g. api.my-app.com
